stops.name: Lough Hyne
stops.detail: Lough Hyne (Irish: Loch Oighinn) is a marine lake in West Cork, Ireland, located about 5 km southwest of Skibbereen.

stops.name: Saint-Bridgit-Kirche
stops.detail: On the lake shore are the ruins of the Saint Bridgit Church as well as the holy wells "Tobarín Súl" and "Skour Well" on the slope of Knockomagh Hill.

stops.name: Tobarín Súl
stops.detail: The holy springs Tobarín Súl and Skour Well are located by the hill Knockomagh Hill, which also features a hiking trail with a spectacular summit view over the lake and its surroundings.
